headline: More Than K7 Billion Paid To FRA Maize Suppliers, Government Says Balance Is Coming
summary: The government says it has paid more than K7 billion to farmers who supplied maize to the Food Reserve Agency in the 2026 season. It assured farmers still waiting that all outstanding payments will be settled.
why: The Food Reserve Agency is Zambia's state grain reserve body, and its payments to maize farmers affect rural incomes and the country's food supply policy.
